# Travelaxis

> Professional visa documentation consultancy, UAE company formation, business setup in Dubai, trade licensing, and related government services. Based in Al Qusais, Dubai, UAE. Content is general information, not legal advice. Travelaxis is a consultancy and does not issue visas or licenses directly — applications are submitted through official UAE government channels or authorized entities.
